summary: The A-03 learning-goal onboarding screen now satisfies the approved wireframe and hifi intent for this audit. It presents the 3/3 onboarding progress state, a product-specific guide and mascot area, goal-setting controls for TOPIK level, target grade, exam date, weekly study time, and weak areas, and previous, skip, and save CTAs. The page renders stably at 360, 768, and 1280 widths with no Next error overlay or console errors.
acceptedVariance: The visual guide uses CSS/lucide-based product art instead of a bitmap mascot asset. It preserves the required guide, mascot, and learning-value region without adding a new asset dependency.

The previous and skip controls are Ant Design buttons that navigate through the existing router/mutation behavior rather than anchor links. This preserves the intended user action and existing save semantics.
Next dev indicator may appear in local screenshots. It is not product UI and is excluded from visual severity.

findings.claim: Resolved: the page clearly communicates that the learner is on step 3 of 3 in onboarding.
findings.observed: Desktop, tablet, and mobile captures show the onboarding progress strip with completed account and email steps and the active learning-goal step.
findings.expected: The A-03 wireframe requires a progress indicator showing the current setup stage.

findings.claim: Resolved: the screen includes a guide, mascot-style visual, and learning benefit area.
findings.observed: The left guide panel presents Talkpik AI branding, a speech bubble, target/pencil visual, and three benefit items for recommendations, feedback, and growth reporting.
findings.expected: The wireframe and hifi require a guide/mascot area explaining why goals and language information support personalized recommendations.

findings.claim: Resolved: the form exposes the documented learning-goal controls while preserving the existing save contract.
findings.observed: DOM inspection confirms TOPIK selection, target-grade radio buttons, exam-date textbox, weekly-time spinbutton, weak-area multiselect, and submit CTA are present. Component tests confirm save validation and mutation behavior.
findings.expected: The functional spec requires TOPIK level, target grade/exam information, weekly goal, and weak-area selection saved to learning_goals.

findings.claim: Resolved: the required previous, skip, and save actions remain visible and behaviorally connected.
findings.observed: The page displays the primary save-and-dashboard CTA, a previous-step button, and a skip button. Skip continues to use the existing minimum-goal mutation before navigating to the dashboard.
findings.expected: The A-03 wireframe requires previous/next CTA coverage, and the functional spec allows continuing or skipping toward B-01 dashboard.

findings.claim: Resolved: the authenticated onboarding route renders cleanly across audited breakpoints.
findings.observed: render-shot captured 360, 768, and 1280 viewports with status 200, errorOverlay=false, and consoleErr=0. Scoped Playwright A-03 e2e passed on mobile-360, tablet-768, and desktop-1280.
findings.expected: The authenticated onboarding route should render without redirect loops, error overlays, console errors, text collisions, or horizontal overflow across audited breakpoints.
